session.title: Recovery absorption or optional easy Suito
session.purpose: Absorb Monday's key Stumpjumper session while optionally preserving low-cost bike rhythm.
session.dose: Complete rest is fully acceptable. If legs and cognition are normal, ride 30-40 minutes seated at 105-120 W and RPE 2 with normal cadence; no torque, tempo or intervals.
session.adaptation_hypothesis: Very low-cost circulation can support recovery and bike continuity without adding meaningful density before Friday's Enduro exposure.
execution_rules: Fresh same-day evidence governs whether the optional spin occurs.
Keep power smooth and finish fresher than the start.

expected_result.session: No accumulating leg heaviness or sympathetic activation.
expected_result.next_day: Normal or improved freshness for Wednesday low-aerobic work.

stop_rules: Skip for poor sleep, gastrointestinal symptoms, illness, pain, abnormal fatigue or impaired CNS readiness.
Stop if RPE rises above 3 or legs worsen.
